caption: The drawing depicts two views of a decorative object, likely a porcelain dish. The upper view shows the dish from above, with a symmetrical, clover-like or butterfly shape. The surface of the dish is predominantly white with scalloped, gold-trimmed edges. The interior is adorned with floral patterns, including pink, purple, blue, and yellow flowers with green leaves, painted on both of the main sections. There are additional gold decorative accents near the edges. In the center of the dish, a molded white handle, also accented with gold, divides the two sides. The lower part of the drawing presents a side elevation view of the dish, showing its shallow, wide body and a curving, ornate handle with scrollwork detail rising above the rim. The drawing is signed "Geoffrey Holt" in the bottom right corner, and the background is plain, unadorned paper.
title: Bowl
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
